feature: Recent Space Race news, human partner discovery and simplified campaign chrome

archive.storage: One latest bulletin per programme; at most 84 national programme bulletins. No duplicated image buffers or growing chronological array are created by this feature.
archive.expiry_clock: Persisted global.num_days expiry date set on a newly issued report, never on replay.
archive.maintenance: The ordinary presentation refresh checks one next-due date. Full bounded scans run at most seven days apart, earlier for the earliest expiry or a new report. Only human countries in the enabled 1970 scenario run maintenance.
archive.old_saves: Untimestamped programme reports receive one finite retention period on migration; no ongoing renewals.
archive.removed: Expired last_report and report_expires variables. Stale selected news is redirected to a retained report or the empty archive.
archive.retained: Programme successes, precursor qualification, world-first records, prestige, research awards, casualties, funds and historical achievements.
archive.performance_boundary: The archive was already bounded. Expiry reduces disposable saved references and archive navigation. It does not unload packaged textures, remove native event definitions, retract an open event window or control the engine-maintained event log.

partner_discovery.eligible: Existing countries controlled by other human players and at peace with the viewing government. AI countries and the viewing country are excluded.
partner_discovery.order: Deterministic native every_country iteration; no RNG.
partner_discovery.empty: No other player country, visible available count, manual Refresh players control and player-only description.
partner_discovery.updates: One automatic scan per visible crew/operations page per game day. Opening those pages invalidates the cache. Explicit cycling refreshes immediately, including a paused join.
partner_discovery.transactions: Country selection creates no offer, payment or qualification. The existing invite and exact recipient-consent guards remain mandatory; role qualifications, capacity and training remain unchanged.
partner_discovery.country_changes: Manual rescan and visible daily refresh replace invalid AI/enemy selections with an eligible country, or zero when none remains.

presentation: Remove duplicate current-date widgets from the header and footer. Historical dates, programme duration and departure windows retain their gameplay meaning.
quarantine: All new functions are automatically protected by the persistent GC emergency switch.

sources.source: Existing native Space Race compiler and MD country-scope/GUI conventions in this repository
sources.author_credit: Existing IMPERIA COLD WAR and Millennium Dawn contributors; individual attribution unknown where not recorded in upstream files
sources.licence_or_permission: Unknown beyond existing project notices; no new third-party material added
sources.modifications: Original bounded archive logic, deterministic selector maintenance, English empty states and removal of duplicate date labels

assets: No new images, flags, font atlases or third-party downloads. Existing art and native flag rights remain governed by the separate asset notices.

validation.method: Generated Clausewitz AST and actual generated GUI callback execution in the local transaction model; native layout render
